verdict.rationale: Jan's privacy doc states "Zero data collection until you say so," which describes an opt-in default where telemetry stays off unless the user consents. The README's "Privacy First: everything runs locally" framing supports this posture. Beyond that single line, the evidence documents no settings toggle, no list of what data is collected, and no way to revoke consent after opting in. missing for 10: documented telemetry settings toggle and revocation flow, a disclosure of what data is collected when enabled, independent or hands-on confirmation that no data is sent by default.
